title: Revealing the Seen, Imagining the Beyond: A Survey of Image-Grounded Chain-of-Thought Reasoning in Multimodal LLMs
best_for_zh: 构建或评估多模态图像扎根推理数据的读者。
one_line: An ACL survey of multimodal reasoning processes that alternate between text and visual state updates.
梳理文字理由与视觉状态交替更新的多模态推理过程的 ACL 综述。
why: It makes the intermediate visual state a first-class object when judging whether a multimodal explanation is grounded.
inclusion_reason: A 2026 ACL long paper that directly connects multimodal intermediate reasoning, supervision format, benchmark design, and data quality.

title: Problem
问题
html: Multimodal models can give a polished explanation without clearly showing which image evidence supports each step. This ACL survey studies image-grounded chain-of-thought, where textual reasoning is interleaved with visual state updates. It matters whenever a task needs fine perception, geometry, games, planning, or an imagined next state.
多模态模型能给出流畅解释，却未必说明每一步由哪段图像证据支持。该 ACL 综述研究图像扎根思维链：文字推理与视觉状态更新交替出现。它适用于细粒度感知、几何、游戏、规划和想象下一状态等任务。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey formalizes image-grounded chain-of-thought as a process rather than a final answer format. Its taxonomy compares prompting, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning, then links each family to benchmarks. The useful question is not only whether the final answer is right, but whether the image update makes the next textual inference better supported.
本文把图像扎根思维链视作一个过程，而不是最终答案格式。它比较提示、监督微调和强化学习三类方法，并把它们连接到基准。最关键的问题不只是答案是否正确，而是视觉更新是否让下一步文字推断获得更充分支持。

title: Method
方法
html: Use the taxonomy to inspect a dataset or paper in five parts: input image and question, textual rationale, visual-state representation, supervision or reward, and final evaluation. The survey does not provide a shared training set, so check whether a primary method stores regions, generated images, symbolic states, or only free-form text. That difference changes what can be verified.
可以用这套分类检查数据集或论文的五部分：输入图像和问题、文字理由、视觉状态表示、监督或奖励、最终评测。综述未提供统一训练集，因此要确认原始方法保存的是区域、生成图像、符号状态，还是只有自由文本；这会改变过程能否被核对。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The ACL abstract identifies two settings with particular value: detail-oriented reasoning and imagined-world reasoning. It also names efficiency, data quality, and generative capability as open challenges. Treat those as screening criteria when reading a primary result: ask which visual state is observed, which is generated, and how each one is checked against the task.
ACL 摘要指出两类特别有价值的场景：细节导向推理与想象世界推理，并把效率、数据质量和生成能力列为开放问题。阅读原始结果时可据此筛选：哪个视觉状态来自观察，哪个由模型生成，每一种如何与任务要求相互核对？

title: Novelty
新意
html: Many multimodal surveys discuss capabilities at the model level. This paper centers the alternating intermediate process: verbal steps plus a changing visual state. That is a practical data contribution because it exposes missing fields that final-answer datasets usually omit, such as where a state came from and whether it was used by a later step.
不少多模态综述从模型能力层面讨论问题。本文把“语言步骤加不断变化的视觉状态”这一交替过程放在中心。这对数据设计很实用，因为它暴露出只存最终答案的数据常缺少的字段，例如状态来源，以及后续步骤是否真的使用了该状态。

title: Limitations
局限
html: An intermediate image can look convincing while still failing to represent the required relation. Generated visual states add compute cost and can introduce new errors. Cross-benchmark comparisons are difficult because tasks differ in what counts as visual grounding, so do not compare methods by accuracy alone.
中间图像可能看起来合理，却没有表达任务所需关系。生成视觉状态会增加计算成本，也会引入新错误。不同基准对“图像扎根”的要求不同，因此不能只按准确率比较方法。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For a student project, use this card to specify a process record before collecting examples. Store the question, the image evidence chosen at each step, the textual inference, the next visual state, and an evaluation rule for the connection. This creates a dataset that can reveal whether a model used visual evidence instead of merely producing a plausible narrative.
做学生项目时，可先用这张卡规定过程记录：问题、每一步选取的图像证据、文字推断、下一视觉状态，以及二者连接的评测规则。这样得到的数据才能显示模型是否真的使用了图像证据，而不只是写出貌似合理的叙述。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Read one prompting method and one training-based method side by side. For each, draw the sequence “image evidence → text step → visual update → answer,” then mark which arrows have supervision or evaluation. The blank arrows are often more important than the headline score because they reveal where a claimed process remains unsupported.
建议并排读一种提示方法和一种训练方法。对每种方法画出“图像证据 → 文字步骤 → 视觉更新 → 答案”，再标出哪条箭头有监督或评测。空白箭头往往比分数更值得关注，因为它揭示了过程主张还缺少什么支持。

引用
